BibleLens: measured control inventory

Decision report · CSV inventory · Full computed/rule evidence

Live build 241, October 18, 2026. 232 page/panel/state captures; 1358 measured variant records, deduplicated to 677 rows below. Every variant has its own cropped screenshot; click to enlarge. Width/theme-dependent variants remain separate.

*Recorded placements count states, not unique product-wide controls. Underlying page controls can also appear in modal captures in the first passes; targeted captures isolate active dialogs. The decision report uses explicit content snapshots for counts. Dynamic names, content wrapping, hover/focus and expanded states can create more than one row for a control. Fill includes the computed gradient separately; matching rules include overridden declarations, and do not imply every property wins. Lines map to this checkout's src/style.css; Timeline also has its own stylesheet. A hidden legacy rule is not a visually observed variant.

Inner input heights are not outer search-box heights. Raw radio inputs are not the visible target: use the labeled picker rows in targeted captures. Target flags consider both measured dimensions; the mode column lists viewport width. Contrast ratios on gradients are estimates, not confirmed failures. Flat ratios do not include glyph antialiasing; disabled controls are excluded from failures. Text in child badges can be smaller than its parent: see small-text scan and report.
